description: Ex-US Army TH-1F, once registered VH-LIQ in Australia. Suffered a total power loss on 8 December 2009 and was severely damaged, then brought up to static display standard at Caloundra airport. Displayed at Nyngan marked A2-1022, replacing the original A2-1022 gifted in recognition of RAAF assistance during the 1990 Nyngan floods, which moved to Caloundra RSL in 2011.
aliases: TH1; TH1F; UH-1; UH1; Iroquois; A2-1022
